# Vendored LiteRT C API headers

Public C API headers from [google-ai-edge/LiteRT](https://github.com/google-ai-edge/LiteRT) (Apache License 2.0, Google LLC — license headers retained in each file), vendored so the app builds without a LiteRT checkout. `build_config.h` is the empty generated stub. The C API is append-only, so these headers work against the embedded ai-edge-litert 2.1.6 runtime pair.
